builds.name: Arcane/Fire PoM-Pyro (PvP)
builds.summary: Presence of Mind into Pyroblast with Impact, Blast Wave and Improved Counterspell; the classic burst-PvP hybrid.

builds.name: Deep Arcane (PvE)
builds.summary: Deep Arcane to Arcane Power with Presence of Mind and Missile Barrage; focus is unclear in the data, labelled PvE-leaning (low confidence).

builds.name: Deep Fire Combustion (PvE)
builds.summary: Deep Fire to Combustion with Arcane Concentration and Elemental Precision; a raid-style build.

builds.name: Deep Frost Control (PvP)
builds.summary: Full Frost: Ice Barrier, Ice Block, Cold Snap, Permafrost, Improved Frost Nova, Arctic Reach; the control and survival build.

builds.name: Offensive Elementalist (PvE)
builds.summary: Frost foundation 10-32 for control and defensives (Ice Block 25, Cold Snap 30), then Fire 33-59 for Impact/Heating Up burst. Level 60: Elemental Precision 3/3, +1% hit on every Fire and Frost spell, which never goes to waste against level-63 bosses and helps whichever nuke you use. (The v0 model favours Frost Channeling 1/3 only because it still casts Frostbolt at 60; see #57.)

builds.name: Offensive Elementalist (PvP)
builds.summary: Frost foundation 10-32 for control and defensives (Ice Block 25, Cold Snap 30), then Fire 33-59 for Impact/Heating Up burst. Level 60: Permafrost 1/3, rated core against melee by the consensus sources (longer, stronger chills for kiting); Improved Frost Nova 1/2 is the close alternative.

builds.name: Fire/Frost Shatter (PvE)
builds.summary: Most popular complete Forever build: Fire burst and mana talents (Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Fire Power, Heating Up) with Frost's Shatter, Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost; no Ice Block or Cold Snap, so PvE-leaning.

frostfire_periodic_can_crit.why: Client spell data flags Frostfire Bolt's periodic part as able to crit.

frostfire_ticks_trigger_impact.why: Unknown whether each Frostfire Bolt tick, or only the direct hit, can roll Impact's stun.

burning_soul_protects_frostfire.why: Burning Soul names Fire spells; Frostfire Bolt counts as both schools, so it probably applies.

frostfire_interrupt_lockout.why: Which school(s) an interrupt locks when it lands on a Frostfire Bolt cast.

fingers_of_frost_applies_to_frostfire.why: Unknown whether Fingers of Frost charges count Frostfire Bolt as a Frost spell.

aoe_target_cap.why: Client data has no MaxTargets on mage AoE; players report damage falling off past 4 targets.

caveats: Questing and raid scenarios use a filler-plus-weaves rotation (Fire Blast, Scorch, Pyroblast, Ice Lance); Combustion, utility and PvP talents are not modeled yet (#57).
Stats, mob HP and mana budgets are rough Classic-era defaults (low confidence).

Respecs: Dual Specialization reportedly unlocks at 40, so a PvP and a PvE build can be carried together from then on. Before 40 a respec costs gold at a class trainer; the launch price is unpublished (beta charges 1 silver; guides assume Classic's 1g, 5g, then +5g per respec up to 50g). See docs/research/forever-facts.md.
